sections.description: Front-end assets and theme files by Damson Website Design.
sections.changelog: * Per-site settings moved out of style.css. Colours, spacing, header height, line lengths, custom CSS and the admin bar toggle now live in Appearance > Damson Settings and are stored in the database, so theme updates no longer overwrite them. Saved values print as a :root block after the child stylesheet. If you changed colours in style.css on 1.0.4 or earlier, this one update replaces that file: re-enter the colours in Damson Settings afterwards. From 1.0.5 onwards updates keep every setting.
